_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from the saved document. derived = arithmetic done here from sourced values (is_derived = the value itself is derived). effective = a value chosen so that the explorer reproduces the published optics where its one-beam model cannot represent the design (white pupil). alternatives = other sourced values. Every quote was machine-checked against the saved file's extracted text.
_meta.quote_normalization: Quotes copied from tag-stripped HTML (table cells joined by whitespace; the ' | ' cell separators of the repository Markdown tables are kept in the quotes and ignored by the check), raw repository text (.md, .yaml, .dat, .csv; .dat rows re-spaced with single spaces), decoded JSON (Crossref) and pdftotext layout/raw (O95). The check compares with all whitespace and '|' removed, case-folded, after NFKC and normalization of primes/double primes, curly quotes, dashes (incl. U+2011), minus signs, micro signs and multiplication signs; ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces.

zspec_common.title: Keck I / ZShooter ZSpec, shared optics (Right Nasmyth feed, f/14.5 -> f/10.5 relay, 10" slit, asymmetric white-pupil R2 echelle, VPH cross-dispersers, 225 mm cameras; two spectrometers, six channels; design stage)
zspec_common.recommended_preset: Six presets, one per channel, at the 0.70" slit (the slit for which the sources quote the median R = 18,000 and the 4.46-px sampling, and the slit of the L1/L2 natural-seeing requirement). Shared inputs: D = 10.95 m (explorer Keck convention, O95: 150 m / f/13.7), F = 10.0 (DERIVED: f_col / W = 1500/150; equivalently the published 530.6 um/arcsec slit scale on 10.95 m gives f/9.995), nObj = 1, slit 0.70" x 10", collimator = mirror (first off-axis parabola, f = 1500 mm, W = 150 mm), camera = 270 mm EFFECTIVE (the published 225 mm f/1.8 camera on the 125 mm white pupil formed by the second, 1250 mm collimator; 225 x 1500/1250 = 270 mm, the 'dispersion_focal_length' of the project's own simulator), R2 echelle delta = 65.6 deg, theta = 0 (not published), gamma = 0.6 deg, eG = 50.15 /mm (VIS) or 24 /mm (NIR); cross-disperser = VPH, first order, entered with the EFFECTIVE line density G x 225/270 so that the 270 mm camera gives the real order spacing (the G-CLEF white-pupil convention); detectors 2048 (dispersion) x 4096 (VIS qCCD) or 2048 x 2048 (NIR LmAPD), 15 um. lamC = blaze of the order the project's simulator places nearest the detector center (DERIVED). Alternative presets: the same six at 0.33" (median R = 38,000, 2.10 px).
